entries.source: A market stall, it looks abandoned..
entries.target: 一个市场摊位，看起来被遗弃了……

entries.source: You loot the stall and gain:
entries.target: 你洗劫了这个市场摊位，获得了：

entries.source: #GOLD#The conduit shatters open, releasing huge angry alligators!
entries.target: #GOLD#管道破裂，释放出愤怒的巨大鳄鱼！

entries.source: This door seems to have been sealed off. You think you can open it.
entries.target: 这扇门似乎被封住了，你觉得你可以打开它。

entries.source: This rock is loose, you think you can move it away.
entries.target: 这块岩石看起来有些松动，你觉得你可以移开它。

entries.source: This thing looks like an alligator, but it has unnaturally large, grey eyes. It gazes at you with great intensity.
entries.target: 这个东西看上去像是只鳄鱼，但是它有一双大得不自然的灰色眼睛，正紧紧地盯着你。
